🐟 Welcome to My Fish Park! 🏝️
Design your own underwater paradise where every fish has a home. Collect, raise, and show off unique fish while building the ultimate park for visitors to enjoy.

🎣 What you can do:

Build and decorate your very own fish park

Unlock rare fish and display them in your tanks

Upgrade habitats to keep your fish happy

Invite friends to explore your park

Will your park become the biggest water attraction? 🌊✨

New players get cash boost!

Your eggs hatch offline, you get visits offline, earn money offline!. Play offline,
